subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand how the Acme Health team is validating the summarization workflow. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment:

- Pilot scope: ingest -> convo summarization -> EHR tagging (approx. 3-5 templates).
- Current ask: more time and credits to ramp integrations and run the longer tail of exemplar docs.
- Info I need from you to finalize approval: expected token volumes (peak/day and avg/day), current trial burn rate, and target budget range for production (monthly). Also helpful: any unit-econ targets (target $/1M tokens) to keep us aligned.

As discussed, I can escalate a 2-week credits extension while we get procurement lined up — will confirm after internal approval. If you can send the current usage export and the rough budget range today, I’ll push this through.

Suggested next step: you send the usage snapshot + any procurement timeline; I’ll follow up with an internal note + formal extension offer.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: pilot-usage-export.csv (please attach the CSV of token usage)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for offering to look into an extension. Per your ask:

- Current pilot burn rate (last 7 days): avg ~1.2M tokens/day, peak ~3.8M tokens/day (spikes during batch imports).
- Expected for next two weeks as we ramp integrations: avg ~2.0M tokens/day, peak ~4.5M tokens/day.
- Budget range we’re modeling for production: $6k–$15k / month (depends on latency SLA and if we go with a cheaper quantized variant).
- Internal target unit economics: ideally <= $200 per 1M tokens, but we can be flexible during pilot.

I attached the usage export and a quick note from engineering on import cadence. Procurement is hoping to complete terms within 3 weeks but would like to avoid disrupting validation. Would appreciate a 2-week credits extension so we can finish e2e testing.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Engineering Lead, Acme Health
jordan.lee@acmehealth.com

---
Attachment: pilot-usage-export.csv (attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Jordan — perfect, this is exactly what I needed. Appreciate the clarity on volumes and the target unit-econ. Quick update from my side after discussing with Rishi and the commercial team: 

- We can approve a one-time extension of $20,000 in pilot credits (applies to token usage) for 14 days to cover the ramp window you described. This should be sufficient to cover ~10–12 days at your projected ramp (assuming some batching optimizations).
- Our target production list price to aim for (for planning purposes) is roughly $250 per 1M tokens for the standard quantized runtime; we can get to ~$200/1M with a committed Dedicated/Reserved posture + some batching/quantization changes. I’ve noted your $200 target to discuss with pricing leads.
- To maximize the extension: enable prefix caching for repeated templates and switch the heavy import jobs to the night batch window (if possible) — that should reduce peak token churn.

I’ve attached the short SOW/terms that will accompany the credits extension. If procurement signs off on the SOW, we can convert the credits into a trial addendum. Procurement contact: you can loop procurement@acmehealth.com and I’ll coordinate the DocuSign link.

I’ll send the formal credits addendum (DocuSign) and a calendar invite for a 1-week burn-rate check-in.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

---
Attachments: Pilot_SOW.pdf (stub), pilot-usage-export.csv (we received), DocuSign link to follow

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700

Amazing — thank you, Marissa. The $20k extension will keep us moving. I’ll loop procurement and watch for the DocuSign. Scheduling the 1-week check-in works for us — suggest Tue next week if that’s open on your side.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Jordan
